headline: 1 S&P 500 Stock to Consider Right Now and 2 That Underwhelm
summary: While the S&P 500 (^GSPC) includes industry leaders, not every stock in the index is a winner. Some companies are past their prime, weighed down by poor execution, weak financials, or structural headwinds.

headline: IQVIA Gears Up to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in the Offing?
summary: IQV heads into its Q2'26 earnings release with y/y revenue and EPS growth expected, supported by AI adoption, drug launches and high-margin segment gains.
